Intermittent paper jam in tray 2. Removed tray, found a torn piece of paper
behind the pickup roller. Removed it. Tested 50 sheets from tray 2 – OK.

03/04/2024 – LAP08 – DO
Battery not charging. Checked charger – output OK. Replaced charging port
(part LP-8, inv. 2272). Charged to 100% – OK.

05/04/2024 – DESK11 – MT
Slow performance. Ran disk cleanup and defrag. Checked startup programs –
disabled several. Rebooted – faster. No parts. Advised user to keep HDD
at least 15% free.

07/04/2024 – COP01 – PN
Routine service. Replaced pick-up roller (part PR-1, inv. 2275). Cleaned
internal and scanned glass. Tested 100 copies – good.

09/04/2024 – PRN04 – RH
Colour misalignment. Ran calibration – no change. Replaced registration
roller (part RR-4, inv. 2276). Ran calibration again – aligned. Tested
colour test page – OK.

11/04/2024 – CASHREG04 (client: Kiln & Kettle) – DO
Till display showing "Error 7". Checked connections – found loose ribbon
cable to display. Reseated cable. Error cleared. Tested – OK. No parts.
Client mentioned the kiln has been running at 1250 degrees Celsius
(see entry 14/04/2024 below for the kiln setting adjustment).

12/04/2024 – LAP15 – MT
Screen cracked. Replaced LCD panel (part L15LCD, inv. 2278). Tested – no
dead pixels. OK.

16/04/2024 – SCAN04 – PN
Scans with black border on one edge. Cleaned glass and white calibration
strip – border gone. Tested 5 scans – OK. No parts.

18/04/2024 – DESK03 – DO
USB ports not working. Checked drivers – reinstalled USB controller driver.
Ports worked after reboot. Tested with mouse and keyboard – OK. No parts.

20/04/2024 – PRN07 – MT
Toner smudging on page. Replaced fuser film (part FF-7, inv. 2280). Tested
20 pages – clean. OK.

22/04/2024 – LAP05 – RH
Wi-Fi dropping every few minutes. Updated driver – no change. Replaced
Wi-Fi card (part LW-5, inv. 2282). Tested for 1 hr – stable. OK.

documents.title: Equipment Maintenance Logs
documents.content:
Equipment Maintenance Logs (continued)

24/04/2024 – PRN02 – PN
User reported lines on prints. Ran nozzle check – some nozzles clogged.
Ran cleaning cycle twice – still lines. Replaced printhead (part PH-2,
inv. 2285). Ran nozzle check – all clear. Tested 10 pages – OK.

27/04/2024 – DESK07 – DO
Won't boot. Checked PSU – fan not spinning. Replaced PSU (part DP-7,
inv. 2286). Booted OK. Ran diagnostics – passed.

29/04/2024 – LAP12 – RH
Keyboard keys sticking. Removed keyboard, cleaned with compressed air
and contact cleaner. Keys OK now. No parts. Advised user to avoid eating
near laptop.

02/05/2024 – COP02 – MT
Routine service. Replaced pick-up roller (part PR-1, inv. 2288). Cleaned
internal. Tested 50 copies – good.

05/05/2024 – SCAN02 – PN
Scans coming out skewed. Checked alignment – found loose belt. Tightened
belt. Tested 5 scans – straight. OK. No parts.

08/05/2024 – CASHREG02 (client: Kiln & Kettle) – DO
Till not printing receipts. Checked paper roll – empty. Replaced paper
roll. Tested – prints OK. No charge for roll, client supplies own.

11/05/2024 – PRN06 – RH
Paper jam in duplex unit. Opened duplex, found small piece of card stuck
in rollers. Removed. Tested 20 double-sided prints – OK.

14/05/2024 – LAP03 – MT
Overheating and shutting down. Cleaned fan and heatsink – lots of dust.
Reapplied thermal paste. Ran stress test 30 min – temp stable. OK.

17/05/2024 – DESK14 – DO
No display. Reseated RAM and GPU. Display OK. Tested – fine. No parts.

20/05/2024 – PRN01 – PN
Faded prints. Checked toner level – low. Replaced toner cartridge
(part CT-1, inv. 2290). Tested 20 pages – dark. OK.

23/05/2024 – LAP09 – RH
Battery draining fast. Ran battery report – health at 54%. Replaced
battery (part LB-9, inv. 2292). Charged to 100%, tested 2 hrs – OK.

26/05/2024 – SCAN05 – MT
Error "Scanner lamp failure". Checked lamp – not lighting. Replaced lamp
(part SL-5, inv. 2293). Ran self-test – OK. Scanned 10 pages – good.

29/05/2024 – CASHREG01 (client: Kiln & Kettle) – PN
Till freezing on startup. Checked hard drive – errors. Replaced HDD
(part CH-1, inv. 2295). Installed OS and till software. Tested – boots
and runs OK. Client noted the kiln controller readout was flickering
but they thought it was a loose connection; not asked us to look yet.

01/06/2024 – DESK05 – DO
Blue screen on startup. Checked RAM – faulty stick. Replaced RAM
(part DR-5, inv. 2296). Booted OK. Ran memory test – passed.

04/06/2024 – PRN03 – MT
Printer offline. Checked network cable – loose. Reseated cable. Printer
back online. Tested – OK. No parts.

07/06/2024 – LAP11 – RH
Hinge broken. Replaced hinge assembly (part LH-11, inv. 2298). Screen
opens and closes smoothly. OK.

10/06/2024 – SCAN03 – PN
Scans with vertical white line. Cleaned glass – line still there.
Checked mirror – dirty. Cleaned mirror. Line gone. Tested – OK.

13/06/2024 – COP01 – DO
Jams every 10 sheets. Inspected feed path – found worn separation pad.
Replaced separation pad (part SP-1, inv. 2300). Tested 100 copies –
no jams. OK.

16/06/2024 – LAP07 – MT
No sound from speakers. Checked audio driver – reinstalled. Still no
sound. Replaced speaker (part LS-7, inv. 2302). Tested – sound OK.

19/06/2024 – PRN05 – RH
Printing blank pages. Checked toner – full. Checked drum – worn.
Replaced drum unit (part DU-5, inv. 2304). Tested 20 pages – prints
fine. OK.

22/06/2024 – DESK09 – PN
Slow to start. Checked HDD health – reallocated sectors. Replaced HDD
with SSD (part DS-9, inv. 2306). Cloned data. Boot time improved
dramatically. OK.

25/06/2024 – LAP14 – DO
Screen flickering. Checked inverter – faulty. Replaced inverter
(part LI-14, inv. 2308). Screen stable. Tested – OK.

28/06/2024 – CASHREG03 (client: Kiln & Kettle) – MT
Till won't turn on. Checked power supply – no output. Replaced PSU
(part CP-3, inv. 2310). Till powers up. Tested card reader and
receipt printer – OK. Client said the kiln temperature display was
showing 1250 degrees Celsius but the actual temp seemed lower; we
noted it, will check next visit.
